# Symbols and Labels

## Device Symbols

### Safety Symbols

| Symbol | Meaning |
|--------|----------|
| ⚠️ | Warning/Caution |
| ⚡ | Electrical Hazard |
| ♻️ | Recyclable |
| 🚫 | Do Not Dispose in Regular Waste |

### Regulatory Symbols

| Symbol | Meaning |
|--------|----------|
| CE | CE Mark (if applicable) |
| Ⓡ | Manufacturer |
| 📅 | Date of Manufacture |
| SN | Serial Number |

## Label Information

Device labels include:

- Manufacturer name and address
- Device model and serial number
- Manufacturing date
- Applicable standards and certifications
- Safety warnings

---

*Symbols conform to ISO 15223-1 (Medical Devices Symbols)*
